check_box.label: Build/Edit
check_box.name: edit_camera_movement
check_box.tool_tip: Use automatic camera positioning when entering and exiting edit mode

check_box.label: Appearance
check_box.name: appearance_camera_movement
check_box.tool_tip: Use automatic camera positioning while in edit mode

check_box.label: Cinematic head tracking
check_box.name: cinematic_camera
check_box.tool_tip: In third person, the camera follows your head's motion and tilts with it (from Black Dragon).

slider.label: Roll damping
slider.name: camera_max_roll
slider.tool_tip: How strongly head tilt is damped back to level (1 = the camera never rolls).

combo_box.name: camera_follow_joint
combo_box.tool_tip: Pin the third-person camera focus to a skeleton bone (plus the camera preset's focus offset). Overrides cinematic head tracking.

check_box.label: Walking brings the camera back
check_box.name: motion_resets_camera
check_box.tool_tip: After you move the camera away (Alt-orbit, middle-mouse, a click-to-look), walking, flying or click-to-walk eases it back behind you. Off: it stays where you put it until you press Esc or reset it. (Same setting as Photo Studio's camera page.)

check_box.label: Smooth camera zoom
check_box.name: camera_smooth_zoom_check
check_box.tool_tip: Ease the wheel zoom toward its target distance and use fine touchpad / high-resolution wheel deltas. Tune with CameraSmoothZoomTime in Debug Settings.

check_box.label: Smooth scrolling in lists and panels
check_box.name: ui_smooth_scroll_check
check_box.tool_tip: Scroll lists, panels, chat and inventory by pixel from touchpad / high-resolution wheel deltas, and ease each wheel notch. Tune with UISmoothScrollTime in Debug Settings.

check_box.label: Right-click drag orbits camera
check_box.name: right_drag_orbit
check_box.tool_tip: Hold right-click in the world and drag to orbit the camera around its current focus; nothing happens until the mouse moves. With the camera following your avatar the drag turns the avatar (the camera stays behind it); after an Alt-click object view or an earlier orbit, the camera orbits that focus and your avatar does not turn. Ctrl+Shift pans, Alt zooms. A right-click without moving opens the context menu on release.

slider.label: Drag distance (px)
slider.name: right_drag_orbit_slop
slider.tool_tip: How far the mouse may move (pixels) with the right button held before it counts as a drag instead of a click. 0: the first pixel starts the drag.

check_box.label: Clicking my avatar keeps camera
check_box.name: click_avatar_keeps_camera
check_box.tool_tip: Normally clicking your own avatar brings the camera back behind you. With this on the camera stays put, so a framed shot survives a stray click. (Also in Lightbox > Cam.)

check_box.label: Camera passes through prims
check_box.name: ignorecameraconstraints
check_box.tool_tip: Allow the camera to move without constraints through prims. Ignores the 'push' the simulator applies to your camera to keep it out of objects.

check_box.label: Middle-mouse camera (Blender)
check_box.name: mmb_nav
check_box.tool_tip: Drag with the middle mouse button to orbit around the point under the cursor. Shift+drag pans, Ctrl+drag dollies. A middle click or hold that does not move is still push-to-talk (it starts after a short hold, so a drag never keys the mic). Leaves the camera free, like an Alt-orbit; Esc or walking resets it.

slider.label: Sensitivity
slider.name: mmb_nav_sensitivity
slider.tool_tip: Orbit and dolly speed of the middle-mouse camera. Pan keeps the grabbed point under the cursor.

check_box.label: Widen FoV with speed
check_box.name: speed_fov
check_box.tool_tip: Widen the field of view as you (or the vehicle you ride) move fast, and ease it back when you slow down. Uses your avatar's or vehicle's speed, not camera movement, and is off while building, in Pose Studio and Photo Studio, with the third-person shooter camera or a free (Alt) camera. Snapshots keep your normal field of view.

slider.label: Extra FoV
slider.name: speed_fov_max
slider.tool_tip: The most the field of view widens, in degrees, at the full-effect speed. Keep it modest: large kicks bother some people.

slider.label: Starts at m/s
slider.name: speed_fov_start
slider.tool_tip: Below this speed (m/s) the field of view does not change. Walking is about 3 m/s, running 5, flying 15 to 20.

slider.label: Full at m/s
slider.name: speed_fov_full
slider.tool_tip: At this speed (m/s) the full extra field of view applies. It eases in smoothly between the start and full speeds.

check_box.label: Also in mouselook
check_box.name: speed_fov_mouselook
check_box.tool_tip: Also widen the field of view in mouselook.

panel.label: Movement
panel.name: move_movement_tab

check_box.label: Arrow keys always move me while in chat
check_box.name: arrow_keys_move_avatar_check

check_box.label: Hold jump or crouch to start or stop flying
check_box.name: automatic_fly

check_box.label: Skip the pre-jump crouch (jump instantly)
check_box.name: skip_prejump
check_box.tool_tip: Jump immediately without the crouching pre-jump animation delay.

check_box.label: A/D strafe instead of turn
check_box.name: strafe_with_ad
check_box.tool_tip: A/D and the Left/Right arrow keys strafe (sidestep), and Shift+A/D turn, on foot and flying. Off: A/D turn and Shift+A/D strafe. Only the default key bindings are swapped. Mouselook already strafes with A/D.

slider.label: Keyboard turn speed
slider.name: keyboard_turn_rate
slider.tool_tip: How fast the A/D and Left/Right arrow keys turn your avatar (when they turn rather than strafe). 1.00 is the standard speed. Does not affect strafing, mouselook or the on-screen turn buttons.

check_box.label: Both mouse buttons walk
check_box.name: mouse_walk
check_box.tool_tip: While holding the left mouse button on your avatar to steer, also hold the right button to walk forward (runs or flies per your current mode). Release either button to stop. Not used with the third-person shooter camera.

check_box.label: Left-click never sits me
check_box.name: block_click_sit
check_box.tool_tip: Ignore an object's 'sit on left-click' action, to avoid accidental sits. Left-clicking such an object touches it instead (if it responds to touch). To sit, right-click it and choose Sit Here.

check_box.label: Show system avatar bodies
check_box.name: show_system_avatar_bodies
check_box.tool_tip: Draw the classic system body (skin, eyes, eyelashes, hair, skirt) of every avatar, yours included. Turn off when everyone you see wears a mesh body: avatars without a mesh body will then show ONLY their attachments.

panel.text: Mouselook and the third-person shooter camera are on the Combat tab.
